title: # Let vps.build_start launch Fable builds Brett (Nov 1 2026): the axHub tool `vps.build_start` only…
asked: # Let vps.build_start launch Fable builds Brett (Nov 1 2026): the axHub tool `vps.build_start` only accepts model `opus` or `sonnet` (enum), so Fable builds can't be launched. Fix it. Read CLAUDE.md and the repo rules first. 1. Find the `vps.build_start` tool definition (input schema enum for `model`) and the code that turns `model` into the `claude -p --model <x>` flag for /opt/axf/deploy/claude-headless.sh. 2. Add `fable` (and keep opus, sonnet). Map it to the exact model name/alias the installed Claude Code CLI on this VPS accepts for Fable: check `claude --help` / the CLI's model list / how the AmberX-AXF build orchestrator already names Fable steps, and use that. If the CLI rejects it, report exactly what it says instead of guessing. 3. Better: don't hard-code the list. Read allowed models from axHub config (default opus, sonnet, fable) so new models need no code change; the schema enum is generated from that config. 4. Optional `model` default stays opus. The build_list output shows each build's model. 5. Tests for the schema + mapping, decision log entry, STATUS/THREADS notes. Deploy the way axHub normally deploys (main + Coolify redeploy as the repo documents); do not restart anything the docs don't say to. Commit on this branch, merge origin/main, push the branch. Do NOT push to main; Brett's session lands it with build_land. Never print secrets. Short report: what the enum was, what it is now, the exact CLI model name used for Fable, and whether a live test launch worked. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once.
